name: com.chinavisacalc/mcp
title: ChinaVisaCalc — China Work Permit Points, Z-Visa, Apostille & Expat Tax Engine
description: Calculate China SAFEA work permit points, Z-visa timelines, Apostille rules & expat IIT tax.

tools.name: calculate_safea_work_permit_points
tools.description: Evaluate foreign applicant eligibility across the official 9-dimension 120-point SAFEA Circular [2017] 40 matrix (110 national + 10 local encouragement, including Direct Category B-1 check), native English teacher track, or WFOE entrepreneur track.

track.description: Applicant track: standard points rubric, native language teacher, or WFOE investor/founder.

cityTier.description: Optional municipality context metadata (matrix salary brackets follow nationwide RMB tiers).

salary.description: Dimension 1 (Max 20 pts): Contracted gross annual RMB salary tier.

education.description: Dimension 2 (Max 20 pts): Highest authenticated academic degree or equivalent vocational skill credential.

experience.description: Dimension 3 (Max 20 pts): Post-graduation full-time relevant work experience (<2 yrs=0; 2 yrs=5; +1/yr up to 20 at >=17 yrs).

experienceYears.description: Optional exact integer years of post-graduation relevant experience (overrides `experience` enum if provided).

workDuration.description: Dimension 4 (Max 15 pts): Annual working months in China (>=9m=15, 6-8m=10, 3-5m=5, <3m=0). Defaults to dur_9plus.

age.description: Dimension 7 (Max 15 pts): Applicant age bracket at submission.

chinese.description: Dimension 5 (Max 5 pts): HSK level (HSK 5+/Chinese degree/former PRC=5, HSK 4=4, HSK 3=3, HSK 2=2, HSK 1=1, None=0).

location.description: Dimension 6 (Max 10 pts): loc_western (Western/Northeast/Key Assistance/FTP = +10) or loc_standard (0).

localIncentive.description: Dimension 9 (Max 10 pts): Provincial/municipal urgent talent encouragement (local_0=0, local_5=5, local_10=10).

bonus.description: Dimension 8 (Max 5 pts TOTAL, capped/non-stackable): World Top 100 uni, Fortune Global 500, patent/IP, or >=5 yrs in China.

nativeCountry.description: Teacher track: passport from US, UK, CA, AU, NZ, IE, or ZA.

teflCertified.description: Teacher track: holds 120-hour accredited TEFL/TESOL/CELTA or Education/English degree.

twoYearsTeachingExp.description: Teacher track: 2+ years verifiable post-grad teaching.

registeredCapital.description: Entrepreneur track: registered corporate capital bracket.

hasChineseEmployee.description: Entrepreneur track: active Chinese staff with social security.

hasPhysicalOffice.description: Entrepreneur track: commercial lease filed with housing bureau.

tools.name: optimize_work_permit_score_deficit
tools.description: Diagnose exact point gaps below Category B (60/120) or Category A (85/120) thresholds under SAFEA Circular [2017] 40 (including Direct B-1 check) and rank accurate upgrade levers (work duration, HSK max 5 pts, World Top 100 / Fortune 500 capped 5 pts, Western/FTP +10 pts, provincial encouragement, and exact salary bracket step-ups).

salary.description: Current gross annual RMB salary tier from employment contract.

education.description: Current highest authenticated academic degree or equivalent vocational skill credential.

experience.description: Current post-graduation relevant full-time work experience years.

experienceYears.description: Optional exact integer years of post-graduation relevant experience.

workDuration.description: Current annual working time bracket in China (Max 15 pts).

age.description: Applicant age bracket at time of SAFEA work permit filing.

chinese.description: Current HSK Mandarin proficiency test level held by applicant (Max 5 pts).

location.description: Current work orientation regional classification (loc_western=+10, loc_standard=0).

localIncentive.description: Current provincial/municipal encouragement points (local_0, local_5, local_10).

bonus.description: Already claimed Dimension 8 items (capped at 5 pts total, non-stackable).

tools.name: simulate_expat_iit_and_tax_refund
tools.description: Compare Option A fapiao-backed tax-exempt fringe benefits extended through 2027-12-31 (MOF/STA Circular [2023] No. 29) against Option B Tax App Special Additional Deductions across 7 statutory income tax brackets.

monthlySalaryGross.description: Gross monthly salary in RMB before allowances or tax.

monthlyRentAllowance.description: Monthly housing rent backed by formal fapiao in RMB.

monthlyHomeLeaveAllowance.description: Amortized monthly home-leave airfare allowance in RMB.

hasChildrenEducation.description: Whether applicant pays eligible international/private school tuition.

monthlyChildrenTuition.description: Monthly children tuition allowance with invoice in RMB.

supportElderlyParents.description: Supports parents aged 60+ under Tax App SAD rules.

monthsWorkedInYear.description: Number of tax-resident months worked during the calendar year (1-12).

tools.name: calculate_job_transfer_runway_deadlines
tools.description: Compute dual statutory timelines from a resignation date: 30-day advance notice (Labor Contract Law Art. 37), 10-working-day SAFEA Work Permit cancellation deadline (SAFEA Service Guide), 15-calendar-day social security/archive transfer deadline (Labor Contract Law Art. 50), Day+20 transfer cutoff, and 30-day T-Visa hard expiry.

resignationDate.description: Last working day or official resignation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

employerWithholdingRelease.description: Include labor arbitration & unilateral SAFEA administrative cancellation SOP when former employer withholds papers.

tools.name: verify_country_apostille_and_legalization
tools.description: Look up document authentication requirements across 21 curated issuing jurisdictions to distinguish single-step domestic Hague Apostille from dual-step Chinese Embassy consular legalization, competent bureaus, and turnaround weeks.

countryQuery.description: ISO 2-letter code (e.g., US, GB, CA, AU, DE, SG, TH, VN, AE) or country name; pass "all" to list all 21 countries.

includeTranslationRules.description: Append domestic certified translation seal and 6-month police certificate expiry notes.

tools.name: compare_municipal_work_permit_policies
tools.description: Inspect and compare municipal processing speeds, Greater Bay Area or Hainan FTP 15% income tax rebates, Category B age-65 exceptions, and designated Travel Healthcare Center locations across 7 Chinese hubs.

cityId.description: Primary Chinese municipality or special economic zone to inspect.

compareWithCityId.description: Optional second city to benchmark turnaround days and tax incentives side by side.

applicantAge.description: Optional age check against national Category B cap (60) vs Hainan FTP relaxed ceiling (65).

tools.name: evaluate_fast_track_and_no_degree_pathways
tools.description: Check statutory fast-track exemptions (active Feb 2026 Shanghai ¥895,248/yr & Beijing ¥859,464/yr 6× local average salary thresholds, dynamic municipal formulas, Top-100 postdoc, Fortune 500 executive, Top-100/Chinese Master recent graduate) to see if bachelor degree or 2-year experience rules are waived.

annualSalaryRmb.description: Offered annual pre-tax RMB compensation for checking automatic 6x Category A exemption.

targetCity.description: City wage benchmark group used for 6x local social average salary threshold.

hasBachelorDegree.description: Whether applicant holds an authenticated 4-year university degree.

categoryFilter.description: Filter statutory fast-track clauses by Category A, Category B, or all.

tools.name: generate_visa_execution_roadmap_and_arrival_kit
tools.description: Retrieve end-to-end procedural checklists for overseas Z-visa onboarding, in-country employer changes, X1/S1 status switches, 24h police accommodation rules, and authoritative policy guide briefings.

includeArrivalSurvivalKit.description: Include Alipay/WeChat ¥200 rule, 24-hour PSB registration, ITHC medical check, SIM card, and UnionPay banking steps.

guideSlug.description: Optional deep-dive guide slug to attach statutory TL;DR and FAQ summary.
